# bank-account.close

Close a company's bank account; it takes no more deposits.

**Who may call:** the owner of its account.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 800ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| account | bank-account.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| account | bank-account.id |

## Move

`close`: from open to closed, emitting BankAccountClosed.

## Steps

- `bank-account.close.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| BankAccountNotOpen | 40 | BA-900 | the bank-account is in a state close can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its account.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account closes

Starts from the world `a bank account`.

- **Bo can't close it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends account the world's account, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada closes it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, and gets back the world's account.
- **it can't be closed twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, and is refused with BankAccountNotOpen, BA-900, carrying state `closed`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bank-account close --account <account>
```

HTTP: `POST /bank-account/close` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.bank-account.close(payload)`.

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account closes

Starts from the world `a bank account`.

- **Ada reads it back with the deposit details she was given.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's account, and gets back [the world's company, the world's business, `Operating`, `USD`, the world's bankName, the world's accountNumber, the world's routingNumber, `open`].
- **the new account is a different one.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's account, and gets back `open`.
- **and the old one stays closed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's account, and gets back [`Operating`, `closed`].

### bridge: open a bank account

Starts from the world `kyb approved`.

```sh
capxul bank-account get --id <id>
```

# bank-account.open

Open a bank account for a company whose KYB Bridge approved: answers where to send deposits.

**Who may call:** the owner of its business.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 800ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| business | bank-account.business | The company's approved KYB the account is opened on. |
| accountName | bank-account.accountName | What the company calls the account (ERPNext's `account_name`). |
| currency | bank-account.currency | The currency it takes deposits in. |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| account | bank-account.id |  |
| bankName | bank-account.bankName | The bank that holds it, as Bridge names it. |
| accountNumber | bank-account.accountNumber | Its account number, or IBAN, as Bridge gives it. |
| routingNumber | bank-account.routingNumber | Its routing number, or BIC, as Bridge gives it. |

## Move

`open`: from nothing (it creates) to open, emitting BankAccountOpened.

## Steps

- `bank-account.open.load` (database)
- `bank-account.open.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| KybNotApproved | 41 | BA-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| BankAccountNameTaken | 42 | BA-002 | another open bank account holds this company and account name; by the rule bank-account.oneNamePerCompany, carrying accountName |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its business.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account closes

Starts from the world `a bank account`.

- **a closed account frees its name for a new one.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, and gets back an answer matching `^bac_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### bridge: kyb is decided by bridge

Starts from the world `kyb started`.

- **nor open a bank account before Bridge approves it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, and is refused with KybNotApproved, BA-001.
- **and opens no bank account.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends business the last call's business, accountName `Main`, currency `EUR`, and is refused with KybNotApproved, BA-001.

### bridge: open a bank account

Starts from the world `kyb approved`.

- **Bo can't open an account on Ada's company.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada opens a US dollar account and gets where to send deposits.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `USD`, with the request key `acme-operating`, and gets back an answer matching `^bac_[0-9a-z]+$` and gets back an answer matching `\S` and gets back an answer matching `^\d{4,17}$` and gets back an answer matching `^\d{9}$`.
- **the company has one open account by a name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Operating`, currency `EUR`, and is refused with BankAccountNameTaken, BA-002, carrying accountName `Operating`.
- **she opens a euro account under another name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, accountName `Payroll`, currency `EUR`, and gets back an answer matching `^bac_[0-9a-z]+$` and gets back an answer matching `^[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{10,30}$` and gets back an answer matching `^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bank-account open --business <business> --accountName <accountName> --currency <currency>
```

HTTP: `POST /bank-account/open` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.bank-account.open(payload)`.

# bridge-business.approve

Record that Bridge approved a company's KYB.

**Who may call:** the system.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| business | bridge-business.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| business | bridge-business.id |

## Move

`approve`: from started to approved, emitting KybApproved.

## Steps

- `bridge-business.approve.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| KybAlreadyStarted | 41 | KB-001 | another bridge business holds this company; by the rule bridge-business.oneKybPerCompany, carrying company |
| BridgeBusinessNotStarted | 40 | KB-900 | the bridge-business is in a state approve can't start from; carries `state` |
| BridgeBusinessNotFound | 4 | KB-901 | nothing has the id in business; the handler never runs; carries `id` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the system; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: kyb is decided by bridge

Starts from the world `kyb started`.

- **Ada can't approve her own company's KYB.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends business the world's business, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bridge approves it.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends business the world's business, and gets back the world's business.
- **an approved KYB can't be approved again.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends business the world's business, and is refused with BridgeBusinessNotStarted, KB-900, carrying state `approved`.
- **a turned-down KYB can't then be approved.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends business the last call's business, and is refused with BridgeBusinessNotStarted, KB-900, carrying state `rejected`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bridge-business approve --business <business>
```

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting CompanyCreated.

- `company.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| CompanyAbbrTaken | 42 | CO-002 | another company holds this owner and abbr; by the rule company.oneAbbrPerOwner, carrying abbr |
| CompanyNameTaken | 41 | CO-001 | another company holds this owner and company name; by the rule company.oneNamePerOwner, carrying companyName |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't anyone signed in; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: kyb is decided by bridge

Starts from the world `kyb started`.

- **Bo sets up a company of his own.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Bo Ltd`, abbr `BL`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `KES`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### companies are kept apart

Starts from the world `a company`.

- **Ada can't give a second company of hers the same name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends companyName `Acme Trading`, abbr `AT2`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `USD`, and is refused with CompanyNameTaken, CO-001, carrying companyName `Acme Trading`.
- **nor the same abbreviation.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends companyName `Acme Holdings`, abbr `AT`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `USD`, and is refused with CompanyAbbrTaken, CO-002, carrying abbr `AT`.
- **Bo may use both for his own company, because her names don't bind him.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Acme Trading`, abbr `AT`, country `Uganda`, defaultCurrency `UGX`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada sets up a second company under other names, which she runs too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends companyName `Acme Holdings`, abbr `AH`, country `Uganda`, defaultCurrency `UGX`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### set up a company

Starts from an empty world.

- **Ada sets up a company and runs it.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Acme Trading`, abbr `AT`, country `Kenya`, defaultCurrency `USD`, with the request key `acme`, and is answered.
- **Bo sets up a company of his own, which he runs.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends companyName `Kilimanjaro Coffee Exporters`, abbr `KCE`, country `Tanzania`, defaultCurrency `TZS`, and gets back an answer matching `^com_[0-9a-z]+$`.
